body.prose:
Asked for the right open-ended way to dimensions, the session first made a dimension a holon of its own with a gathering expression, and the author found it a take without reasoning: a brief that is a dimension would need a twin. Reasoned again, being a dimension is what a brief's own body says, with a look, marking all it holds, and the author saw it is knowledge schema, the brief only the pilot's proposal, and nothing the substrate must know.

Then how Markdown is replaced. Prose became a list of typed elements, its three links three types, its parts read from the flow and its confidence line a paragraph of its own type, with Markdown only its text form.

The author asked what is lost if this is all one body, whether words should be addressable, and whether reserved names are what remain; the answer was a holon's interior, elements shaped as holons at a smaller scale, each with a local id and a type of its own, pointed into from outside.

Reading a piece of the store brief written that way, he took a holon's name out of its body to stand beside its identity, and a type's fields with it, and found it double that a holon is a type both by being an instance of Type and by having fields. None of it is built. Decided: dimension as brief schema, the name and the fields out of the body, nested lists, the confidence line as prose.

Then he ratified the interior, the type of types let go, and mould as the word for what a type gives its instances, and set Markdown right: native prose supersedes it, and is not its text form. Pressed further, he found that a prose list typed to hold only typed things made the interior a primitive of its own, and asked whether, since an act should be kept at the fidelity of the act, the elements should not be holons, the whole their namespace. The session, which had argued for the interior, found its reasons wrong or not telling, and said so when he asked what had shifted; prose became holons held by their brief, values within them, and the interior went. What a holon per paragraph costs is to be measured, and leads into the index.

*Reasoned on 2026-11-05 by the session, from the author's words of [2026-11-04](ref:01M6MFK1ND1ADMER6HWMNZA173) and [2026-11-05](ref:01M6MFK1NCN57RZ1N2EVV1C2K5).*
body.title: Dimensions, prose made native, and what a type is
